releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.6 moves the isolated HWM Terminal fast channel in service 0.2.5.5 onto the existing authenticated /api/heartbeat transport. Terminal poll and result modes return before health, Mesh presence or normal remediation processing, so the proven Azure device route is reused without generating fake heartbeats or altering workstation health. The separate terminal command table, 15 second polling, one-shot execution, short expiry, 60 second maximum runtime, bounded output, operator audit identity and process-tree termination remain unchanged. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
